CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tc_assert_benefit_admin(p_actor uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_actor is null or not exists(
    select 1 from public.workers w
    where w.user_id=p_actor and (w.role='admin' or public.tc_has_admin_access(p_actor)) and coalesce(w.is_active,true)=true
  ) then raise exception 'ADMIN_REQUIRED'; end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tc_has_admin_access(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select p_user_id is not null and private.tc_admin_access_allowed(null,p_user_id)
$function$
